notes: Safety and polish, nothing about how keys are sent changed. The uninstaller now refuses to touch any folder that is not actually an install of this app, and removing a second copy no longer takes the real copy's shortcuts and Add or Remove entry with it. An install that fails halfway puts the previous files back instead of leaving a mix. Your Mode Ready skill calibration now travels when you reinstall or move machines, and the updater only ever accepts a package served over https with a matching published fingerprint.
